system.description: You are in a relationship much like marriage with another vampire, granting both of you the benefits of the True Love Merit. Taken alongside Closer Than Blood, this allows a remarkable degree of closeness, even the occasional sharing of Disciplines. Your consort is most likely your equal in power and status; together you present a formidable front, and woe to the fool who comes between you.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book One: Artisans
